catalyst.name: Robber Refit, Immovable Refit, Feedback Refit
catalyst.description:
Grants the Grave Robber trait:
Powered Melee Hits and (Glaive) Melee Kills refill the magazine from reserves.
3 second cooldown between activations.
Grants the Immovable Object trait:
While blocking and stationary:
Glaive Projectiles Hits grant 90% increased Weapon Energy.
Grants the Replenishing Aegis trait:
Refills 1 round into the Magazine from reserves upon blocking damage.
1 second cooldown after activation. Does not work while the magazine is overfilled (assumed).
